name: UI：模版包管理-卡片预览图翻页验证
description: 验证模版包卡片预览图支持左右翻页：左箭头/页码/右箭头

steps.expression: (() => { const detailBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => b.textContent.trim() === '查看详情'); if(detailBtns.length > 2) { detailBtns[2].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const leftArrows = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=left],[aria-label*=left]'); const rightArrows = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=right],[aria-label*=right]'); const pageIndicators = Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/g)).map(m => m[0]); return { hasLeftArrows: leftArrows.length > 0, hasRightArrows: rightArrows.length > 0, pageIndicators: pageIndicators.slice(0,5) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在相关数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 预览图有左右箭头和页码指示(N/M)
